title: New Leaf-Nose Bat
content: National Geographic reports that scientists in Vietnam have discovered a new type of bat.With his beady eyes and strange nose, this guy struck me at first as weird or scary or monstrous. But the more I learn about him, the more beautiful he becomes. According to scientists, the “leaf-nosed” facial protuberances serve as both transmitter and antenna, apparently playing a role in echolocation.Strange New Leaf-Nosed Bat
